احتجزتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَزَتَا (iḥtajazatā) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒa.za.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# اُحْتُجِزَتَا (uḥtujizatā) /uħ.tu.d͡ʒi.za.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
